spans.s:
A fly.
E.
भम् imitative sound, भा to emit sound, to shine, &c., and ड aff.

f. (-का)
A gnat, a musquito.
E.
भम्भराली a fly, and कन् aff.

f. (-ली)
A fly, especially of a large sort.
E.
भम् imitative sound, repeated, रा to make, and लच् aff.; making a buzzing noise.

m. (-रः)
A sovereign of Magadha; also ŚREṆIKA.

r. 1st cl. (भामते) r. 10th cl. (भामयति)
To be angry or wrathful, to be impatient.

m. (-मः)
1 Passion, wrath.
2 Light, lustre.
3 The sun.
4 A sister's husband.
f. (-मा)
A passionate woman.
E.
भा to shine, and मन् Uṇādi aff.; or भाम to be angry, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
A sister's husband.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-मी-भिनी-मि)
Angry, passionate.
f. (-नी)
A passionate woman.
E.
भाम passion, इनि aff.
